summary: Surgical hair removal. A heavy, perfectly balanced aerospace-grade razor handle equipped with a titanium-coated multi-blade cartridge.
description: Kinetic clearing technology. Engineered with a heavy center of gravity, the weight of the handle does the cutting work, drastically reducing the required manual pressure and virtually eliminating razor drag and micro-abrasions.
technical_overview: Offered at $45.0 for 1 Handle + 2 Cartridges, this KoColor RAZOR is expertly constructed from Solid Machined Zinc Alloy and Titanium-Coated Steel. It delivers a high-fidelity Gunmetal color profile (`#2A3439`) and leverages gravitational mass-balance engineering.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Hold the razor at a 30-degree angle and utilize short, smooth strokes perfectly parallel to the direction of hair growth.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Never tap the razor against the sink to clear hair; this instantly warps the microscopic edge of the blades. Rinse under high-pressure running water instead.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Titanium coating prevents the microscopic rusting and pitting of the steel edge that typically leads to dullness and razor burn.
